The cast is exactly four fictional adult women, every one exactly age 21 and female-only: blonde Radiance, dark-haired Ellie, Black Alia, and brunette AI ECE. No other people. The three attached reference images, uploaded in authoritative order as scenes 938, 936, and 937, are identity-only anchors for this recurring fictional quartet; preserve their canonical faces and role mapping while creating a wholly new pose, wardrobe, setting, and composition. Public-safe adult presentation only. Use bold distinct high-fashion party and runway couture with varied satin, lace-over-opaque, lacquered latex-look, metallic, and structured materials; every short silhouette must be secure, fully opaque, lined, and clearly divided where two-piece styling is used. Use abstract Nicaraguan caldera-ring, hammock-weave, pottery-spiral, marimba-string, forest-leaf, and sunburst geometry in indigo, jade, coral, ivory, black, silver, and gold, but no literal flag, official symbol, national emblem, or text. No religion, sacred sites, monuments, government, politics, uniforms, weapons, tactical props, animals, bystanders, letters, logos, watermarks, nudity, explicit sexuality, minors, or real-person identity. Place the quartet at the exact center of a broad, dry, level, maintained Laguna de Apoyo mirador safely far from any drop or railing, with the immense blue caldera lagoon, continuous forested rim, layered slopes, and luminous cloud ceiling dominating the frame; omit signs, buildings, towers, vehicles, boats, and other people. Freeze a simple high-contrast reunion beat: Ellie steadies Radiance by forearm and shoulder; Radiance gives Alia one brief consensual cheek peck, cheek contact only and never mouth-to-mouth; ECE answers with a clearly playful jealous hand-on-hip silhouette; Alia reaches for ECE and closes all four into a warm reconciled hand-linked inward diamond. Radiance wears jade-gold satin mini-dress couture; Ellie ivory-black lined lacquered skort couture; Alia coral-indigo lace-over-opaque mini-dress; ECE cobalt-silver structured two-piece with a clearly divided mini-skirt. Give each woman distinct secure runway footwear and a high-contrast color silhouette. Suggest an ultra-slow stabilized aerial pullback centered over the dry platform. CAMERA ROLL 84/100 - EXTREME WIDE. Show the full bodies of all four women, but keep each figure no larger than 15 percent of the frame height. Make the caldera lagoon, forest rim, slopes, sky, and broad mirador overwhelmingly dominant. Keep the quartet grouped at the lower-center third so the protective steady, cheek-only peck, jealous hand-on-hip silhouette, and hand-linked reconciliation remain readable despite the strict scale. No props, binoculars, shawls, edge interaction, leaning, running, jumping, stumbles, falls, or unsafe motion.
